question:
Select the figure from the given options that when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf49295654dc46dba03cfef13131938ad5b2dbb3f70683620c08b553b0467ea3.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6d8f88fb6c1aca60fed630fdef0c1b412886834a50b9f4b41fc6731e5240a57.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is,

Logic: The image at the corner moves at the corner in the anticlockwise direction, and the image is the mirror image in the vertical plane in every next step.

The arrow at the center is mirror image of the previous image in horizontal plane.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c18f4bee22aa4e3b6b951e833711867ff22e4f2c03e3c41bd2015771d6fbfe8c.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3526af6153a9db3e9f6e25cd4e2ac48d7c1adb0f124725a33c62f154e054f411.png]
